recommendedTextbook.title: New General Mathematics for Junior Secondary Schools 3
recommendedTextbook.author: M.F. Macrae, A.O. Kalejaiye, Z.I. Chima, G.U. Garba

topics.topic: Number Bases: Conversion Between Base 10 and Other Bases (Base 2, 8)
subtopics: Binary numbers (Base 2) in computing and electronic logic
Converting from Base 10 to Base 2, 5, 8 using successive division
Converting from other bases back to Base 10 using place values
objectives: Explain binary number systems in computer memory
Convert whole numbers between Base 10 and Base 2, 8 with 100% accuracy
Perform basic binary addition and subtraction

topics.topic: Computer Arithmetic: Binary Addition, Subtraction and Logic Gates
subtopics: Rules of binary addition: 1+0=1, 1+1=10, 1+1+1=11
Binary subtraction with borrowing
Elementary logic gates (AND, OR, NOT) truth tables
objectives: Add and subtract binary numerals showing carry-over and borrowing
Construct truth tables for AND, OR, and NOT gates

subtopics: Direct variation: y = kx and graphical representation through origin
Inverse variation: y = k / x and hyperbolic curve
Joint and partial variation formulas with Nigerian commercial contexts
objectives: Formulate algebraic equations connecting directly and inversely proportional variables
Calculate the constant of proportionality k from given initial conditions
Apply variation principles to calculate fuel consumption or freight costs in Nigeria

topics.topic: Factorization of Quadratic Expressions: ax^2 + bx + c
subtopics: Product-sum method for factorizing trinomials when a = 1
Factorizing quadratic expressions when a > 1 by grouping
Difference of two squares: a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b)
objectives: Factorize quadratic expressions into pairs of binomial factors
Apply difference of two squares to simplify arithmetic calculations quickly

topics.topic: Solution of Quadratic Equations: Factorization and Graphical Methods
subtopics: Setting quadratic expressions to zero and solving for roots: (x - p)(x - q) = 0
Plotting quadratic curves y = ax^2 + bx + c on graph paper
Reading roots, minimum/maximum values, and line of symmetry from graphs
objectives: Solve quadratic equations by factorization method
Plot parabolic quadratic graphs with correct axes and scale
Identify roots of quadratic equations from the x-intercepts of the curve

topics.topic: Simultaneous Linear Equations: Elimination and Substitution Methods
subtopics: Concept of simultaneous equations with two unknown variables (x and y)
Solving by elimination method (equating coefficients)
Solving by substitution method and real-life commercial purchasing word problems
objectives: Solve pairs of simultaneous linear equations accurately using elimination and substitution
Formulate simultaneous equations from Nigerian market trading word problems

subtopics: Diagnostic review of number bases, variation, quadratics, and simultaneous equations
BECE standardized diagnostic test
objectives: Assess pupil algebra readiness against Lagos State BECE criteria

topics.topic: Trigonometry: Sine, Cosine and Tangent of Acute Angles (SOHCAHTOA)
subtopics: Opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse in right-angled triangles
Definitions of Sin θ, Cos θ, Tan θ using SOHCAHTOA
Using four-figure trigonometric tables to find angles and lengths
objectives: State trigonometric ratios for acute angles in right-angled triangles
Calculate unknown heights of trees or flagpoles using tangent ratios

topics.topic: Angles of Elevation and Depression: Real-World Surveying Applications
subtopics: Meaning of horizontal line of sight, angle of elevation, and angle of depression
Equality of angle of elevation and angle of depression as alternate angles
Solving word problems involving buildings, cellular masts, and ships
objectives: Draw accurate mathematical diagrams representing angles of elevation and depression
Calculate heights of buildings and distances between objects using trigonometry

topics.topic: Mensuration: Surface Area and Volume of Cylinders, Cones and Spheres
subtopics: Surface area and volume of right circular cylinders (V = πr^2h)
Volume and curved surface area of cones (V = 1/3 πr^2h)
Volume of spheres (V = 4/3 πr^3) and Nigerian water storage containers
objectives: Calculate volume and capacity in liters of overhead water tanks (Geepee tanks)
Solve composite solid mensuration problems

topics.topic: Compound Interest and Commercial Hire Purchase in Nigeria
subtopics: Difference between simple interest and compound interest
Step-by-step year-by-year calculation of compound interest
Hire purchase transactions: deposit, installments, and carrying charges
objectives: Compute compound interest over 2 and 3 years on bank loans in Naira
Calculate total hire purchase cost vs cash price for domestic electronics

topics.topic: BECE Mock Examination Clinic & Speed Drills
subtopics: Full review of 3-year junior secondary mathematics syllabus
WAEC/BECE past question strategies and common candidate pitfalls
objectives: Complete 60 standardized BECE objective and structured theory questions

subtopics: BECE Final Examination administration and script moderation
objectives: Complete junior secondary mathematics evaluation
